With Justt, you can recover revenue using retail-specific evidence that proves legitimate transactions and customer receipt of goods. How Justt wins ecommerce disputes Surface your strongest data automatically Justt pulls delivery confirmations, transaction records, and customer data from merchants, PSPs, logistics providers, and third-party sources, automatically. An Industry Breakdown Watch now View all posts FAQ How does retail chargeback software work? Retail chargeback software works by automating the dispute lifecycle, specifically targeting first-party fraud and delivery disputes. The platform gathers retail-specific evidence, such as proof of delivery and transaction history, to validate legitimate purchases. This technology submits data-driven responses to banks, effectively recovering revenue that would otherwise be lost due to buyer's remorse or confusion. What is first-party fraud and why is it such a problem for online retailers? First-party fraud, AKA friendly fraud or first-party misuse, is when your actual customer disputes a charge they legitimately made. Maybe they forgot about the purchase, didn't recognize the billing descriptor, or simply changed their mind and found a chargeback easier than a return. Unlike stolen card fraud, these people did order from you, did receive the product, and still filed a dispute. It's maddening because you did nothing wrong. Justt helps by pulling the evidence that proves the transaction was legitimate: delivery confirmation to the customer's address, their purchase history with you, IP matching, and any communications where they acknowledged receipt. Banks need to see proof the customer got what they paid for, and Justt builds that case automatically. A customer claims they never received their order, but tracking shows it was delivered. Can Justt help me win that dispute? This is one of the most common eCommerce disputes, and yes, it's winnable with the right evidence. Tracking data alone isn't always enough. Banks want to see delivery confirmation to the cardholder's address, signature if available, photo proof of delivery, and ideally a match between the shipping address and billing address. Justt connects with your logistics providers to pull this documentation automatically and formats it according to what each card network requires. If the customer has a history of similar claims, we include that pattern too. Chargebacks spike during the holidays. How does Justt handle seasonal volume? Peak season is rough. Your order volume jumps, and a few months later the disputes follow. Most teams can handle their baseline dispute load, but when volume doubles or triples, cases slip through the cracks. Deadlines get missed. Justt scales automatically because there's no manual work per case. Whether you're dealing with 50 disputes a month or 500, the platform processes them the same way. You don't need to hire seasonal staff or watch your win rate collapse because your team is overwhelmed. What happens if my chargeback ratio gets too high? Nothing you want to experience. Visa and Mastercard both monitor merchant dispute rates, and crossing their threshold around 0.9% to 1% of transactions depending on the card network) lands you in a monitoring program. That means extra fees, mandatory reporting, and pressure to fix the problem fast. Go higher and you risk the MATCH list, which is a shared database that makes it nearly impossible to get approved by other processors. Some retailers have lost their ability to accept cards entirely. Justt helps keep your ratio healthy by recovering revenue on disputes you'd otherwise lose, and our insights dashboard tracks exactly where you stand. How much time does fighting eCommerce chargebacks actually take? More than most teams budget for. Each dispute needs delivery records pulled from your shipping provider, transaction details from your payment processor, customer communication logs, and sometimes return policy screenshots or product photos. Someone has to compile all of that, format it correctly for the card network, and submit before the deadline. Miss that window and you lose automatically. For a mid-sized retailer handling a few hundred disputes monthly, we're talking 20 or 30 hours a week of someone's time. Justt takes that off your plate by connecting to your systems and handling evidence gathering, formatting, and submission without manual effort.
